name: From Agentic Reasoning to Deterministic Scripts

mentions.name: From Agentic Reasoning to Deterministic Scripts
mentions.description: An essay arguing that AI agents shouldn't reason from scratch on every repeated task, and exploring how an agent's execution history could be compiled into deterministic automations.
mentions.problem: AI agents re-reason from scratch on every repeated task instead of reusing prior execution.
